rationale: Confirmation check for EPMCDME-14073. All seven acceptance criteria from spec.md are satisfied and re-verified against the frozen diff in code-review.diff. Every gate was re-run on a clean `npm ci` install and is green: typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0 with no findings, unit 509/509 files and 5323 passed / 1 skipped, integration 40/40 files and 507 passed / 1 skipped, gitleaks `no leaks found`, and the sanity-ui harness reporting `2 passed in 247.04s (0:04:07)`. Zero blocking findings. The single finding CR-001 is a cosmetic dead-class nit that cannot affect rendering, and is carried forward rather than fixed.

Minimal single-file diff; ESLint and tsc clean. CR-001 is cosmetic.
Tailwind-only change, no sink, redirect, config, or secret involved; gitleaks clean.

findings.summary: `gap-2` on the new single-child wrapper is inert.

finding_status.notes: Not fixed in this MR. `gap` only takes effect between two or more flex items, so with a single child it produces no rendered difference - the class is noise, not a defect. Deferred deliberately to keep the diff to the lines that carry the fix; safe to sweep in any follow-up touching this file.
